title: Flipkart Sampka

image.name: flipkart-sampka-pataudi-hr.png
image.alternativeText: CaseStudy Sunsat Warehousing Image | Pragati Infra Solutions

engagement: Leased complete warehouse of 7.0 lac Sqft to Flipkart
Support to Developer for Pre and Post Construction Compliance
Design and Build with Minimum Project Cost
Supported FKI by providing extra parking in line with the adjacent available land of developer

engagementImage.name: flipkart-sampka-ptaudi-hr.png
engagementImage.alternativeText: CaseStudy Sunsat Warehousing EngagementImage | Pragati Infra Solutions

challenges: 66KV High Voltage Line shifted Underground
Multiple Changes in location of Mezzanine from Flipkart leading to change in PEB design and deliverables
Several restrictions and Lockdown were imposed due to covid-19 second wave resulting in non-availability of required material and manpower
Project location was witnessed 40% of the annual rainfall in 24 hrs resulting in water logging on site and caused disruption in Project

challengesImage.name: flipkart-sampka-pataudi-hr-2.png
challengesImage.alternativeText: CaseStudy Sunsat Warehousing ChallengesImage | Pragati Infra Solutions

achievements: Completed Project in Committed timelines of 9 Months
Longest Underground Warehouse Fire Corridor in Asia
Rain Water harvesting Pond constructed of 7000 cum to recharge underground water and avoid water logging at site
Largest Flipkart Facility in India
Reduced project cost by approx. 5 Crore by value Engineering
Facility with 104 Dock Doors, Truck Parking for 105 Trucks, 81 Car Parking, 25 Nos Bus Parking & 1065 Nos Two-Wheeler Covered Parking

achievementsImage.name: flipkart-sampka-ptaudi-hr-2.png
